what: Hovering a cell in the line-divided black-and-white article grid fills only that cell with its fill color (default accent), the text turns to the on-fill text color, and photos that were grayscale 1 return to color — background, text and photo all use .6s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1). Giving each cell a different fill color (red, navy, white) makes the grid fill in alternating colors. On devices without hover it stays black and white

options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Photo that returns from B&W to color (img · background slot)
options.--fx-fill / --fx-fill-ink: Fill color and the text color on top of it (via style), default var(--kf-accent) · var(--kf-on-accent). For a white panel use --fx-fill: var(--kf-surface); --fx-fill-ink: var(--kf-ink)
options.look: color: Treat the photo as color from the start and paint only the background

note: The original attached .hover with JS on hover (to cover touch devices) — here the same thing is done with :hover under (hover: hover). Line decorations (lines, chevrons) drawn with currentColor follow the text color.
